in_hebrew.name: Hardy
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Brave and strong
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hardy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Hardy is derived from the Old English word 'heard', meaning 'brave' or 'strong'. The name was popular among the Anglo-Saxons and was often given to warriors or those who displayed great courage. In Christian tradition, the name Hardy may be seen as a reminder of God's strength and protection.
